# What is R
R [@R-base] is an open-source language and environment that is primarily used for conducting statistical analyses and managing data. RStudio [@RStudio] is an open-source graphical environment for running R, viewing output, and doing other things (like creating this document). 

The R community is huge and people develop R packages that we can download (through R) and use for specific types of analyses. In later tutorials, we will use many packages, such as the ggplot2 package [@R-ggplot2] and the psych package [@R-psych]. 

```{r include=FALSE}
# automatically create a bib database for R packages
knitr::write_bib(c(
  .packages(), 'bookdown', 'knitr', 'rmarkdown', 'psych', 'ggplot2'
), 'packages.bib')
```
